_comment: Cards that exist only for the tier-owned target test (tests/unit/targets/test_tiered_targets.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_limit_break` is Cloud's Limit Break: each tier of a Tiered spell declares its own targets -- exactly one tapped creature, any number of tapped creatures with different controllers, or none.
